title: BavGround: A Benchmark for Regional Cultural Grounding and Dialect Competence in Bavarian
abstract: arXiv:2608.12894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cultural evaluation of large language models (LLMs) often focuses on high-resource standard languages, leaving regional culture and dialect communities underrepresented. We introduce BavGround, a benchmark for evaluating Bavarian regional cultural grounding and dialect competence across English, German and Bavarian. BavGround contains 206 multiple-choice source questions across eight cultural domains per language, yielding 618 multi-parallel instances, with items covering both broadly accessible cultural knowledge and source-grounded regional knowledge from journalism, historical sources, and specialist literature. We evaluate fifteen 7B-10B open-weight instruction-tuned models and one closed-model reference. Strong multilingual models perform best overall, but performance drops on Bavarian items and source-grounded questions, indicating persistent difficulty with dialectal and localized cultural knowledge. translated_title: BavGround：巴伐利亚地区文化扎根与方言能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的文化评估通常聚焦于高资源的标准语言，导致区域文化和方言群体被忽视。我们引入了BavGround，一个用于评估巴伐利亚地区文化扎根及方言能力的基准测试，覆盖英语、德语和巴伐利亚语三种语言。BavGround包含206道多项选择题源问题，涵盖八个文化领域，每种语言对应一套，共产生618个多平行实例，题目既包括广泛可获取的文化知识，也涵盖来自新闻、历史资料和专业文献的源扎根区域知识。我们评估了十五个7B-10B参数的开源权重指令微调模型和一个闭源参考模型。表现最佳的多语言模型在总体上领先，但在巴伐利亚语项目和源扎根问题上性能下降，表明其对方言和本地化文化知识仍存在持续困难。我们进一步表明，结论...
tldr: 本文提出了BavGround基准测试，用于评估LLM在巴伐利亚地区文化知识和方言能力上的表现，发现多语言模型虽总体最优，但在方言和源扎根知识上仍有明显短板。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BavGround, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' Bavarian regional cultural grounding and dialect competence, revealing that multilingual models excel overall but struggle with dialectal and source-grounded knowledge.
